title: phaseolus vulgaris var. carinatus
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. carinatus, commonly known as the crested kidney bean or pinto bean, is a variety of the common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris). This plant is a rich source of nutrients and has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, regulating blood sugar, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Phaseolus vulgaris var. carinatus include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic, making it effective in treating conditions such as arthritis, hypertension, and kidney stones. The bioactive constituents of this plant include polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
